preconditions.description: The length of the input string s must be between 1 and 10,000 characters.
The input string s must contain at least one word, which consists of alphanumeric characters.

preconditions.expression: all(c.isalnum() or c == ' ' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The input string s must only contain English letters, digits, and spaces.

postconditions.description: The output string must be the words of s in reverse order, separated by a single space.
The output string must not contain any leading or trailing spaces.
The output string must have exactly one space between each pair of words.
